# LLMs, GenAI and agents

::: {.partintro}
Large language models write. They also read, summarise, extract and plan, and teams now wire them into loops that take actions in the world.

This part explains how an LLM produces text, why "just ask for JSON" is harder than it looks, how retrieval gives a model your documents, and how agents observe, decide and act.

It ends with an honest look at where agents break, and at the one step inside every agent that's quietly doing most of the work: the decision.
:::
